text: Lean dev stack: run from source via tsx, bundle start builds with tsdown
description: Dev stack used 2.6 GB PSS, ~2 GB of it tooling (8 tsc watchers, ~28 npm/dotenv wrappers). Dev now runs backend/broker/frontend from source with no watchers; `npm start` builds tsdown bundles. Workspace packages resolve to source everywhere (fixes stale shared/dist in mcp/loop-worker/sessions); embedder loads lazily. Commit: build: run dev from source via tsx, bundle start builds with tsdown.

status.comment: Implemented and verified: npm run check 25/25, build:optional green, MCP bundle + source answer initialize (35 tools), validate:local-runtime PASS. Pending Felix: restart npm run dev and measure, spawn a session + loop worker, semantic search, one npm start run.

reflection: After restart (2026-10-10): dev stack 8 processes, ~800 MB PSS / 1.2 GB RSS (was 36 processes, 2.6 GB PSS / 4.7 GB RSS). Backend at 460 MB PSS includes the lazily loaded embedder — create_idea's related-idea search triggered it, confirming lazy load works. Idle backend without embedder measured ~164 MB RSS. Still open: spawn a wrapped session + loop worker from the new stack; one full `npm start`.
